training_protocol.selection_metric: final persistent VAL audit accuracy minus excess clean-drop penalty
training_protocol.reset: bank/memory reset per TRAIN pass; all adaptive state retained within each sequence

utility_supervision.target: utility + gamma * (raw target V(updated) - raw target V(skip))
utility_supervision.target_network: inherited critic fixed throughout offline fitting; Double-DQN action choice
utility_supervision.reference: same pre-feedback protected reference and replay for all alternatives
utility_supervision.isolation: copied Context and Adam per alternative; original bank/history/RNG unchanged

min_max: selector maximizes correctness/transfer return; selected Context minimizes current and protected-memory loss
